findings.body: When Node is absent, `pytest.skip()` aborts the entire `test_36_client_apps_simple` test because this helper is called at tests/test_standards.py:67. This skips both the new logger assertions and the existing worker-brief and command-guide checks at lines 69–96, allowing regressions to pass the suite. The suite command in forge.toml:5 provisions only Python dependencies, and .github/workflows/forge.yml:19–21 does not explicitly provision Node. Ensure the required logger check runs in the supported test environment, and isolate it so its prerequisites cannot suppress the existing checks.
